hoi.pt.goi_y.bep: Eight Mansions places the stove by the rule 'sit on a weak direction, face a good one': the back of the stove sits on one of your weaker directions ({xau}) to 'press down' on it, while the stove faces — the way the cook looks while cooking — one of your good directions, ideally Tian Yi ({ty}) or Yan Nian ({dn}). In practice a stove also needs good ventilation, a little distance from the sink, and should not sit right in line with the front door.
hoi.pt.goi_y.giuong: For the bed, Eight Mansions points the head of the bed (where the top of your head points when lying down) to one of the sleeper's good directions: Tian Yi ({ty}) for sleep and health, Yan Nian ({dn}) for a harmonious couple, Fu Wei ({pv}) for stability. Avoid {xau}. In practice the headboard should rest against a solid wall, not sit under a beam, and not face the door directly.

hoi.pt.nha_nguy_hiem: This sounds like a safety emergency in your home right now, not a feng shui question.
